author: Joka.ca
install_msg: AutoDelete installed. Bot messages will auto-delete based on your guild's `[p]set deletedelay` setting. Use `[p]autodelete exclude #channel` to protect specific channels.
name: AutoDelete
short: Auto-delete bot messages after the configured delay.
description: Universally auto-deletes bot messages after the guild's configured delete_delay. Covers slash commands, interactions, and text command responses that Red's core delete_delay misses. Supports per-channel exclusions, safe task cancellation on unload, and fail-safe error handling.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord channel IDs for the exclusion list. No user data is stored.
